proposals.definition: The causal-reconstruction strand using USGS seismic interpretation, satellite imagery and Himalayan geography to explain collapse/debris flow. Read originals distinguish a landslide-generated signal from an initiating earthquake. Terrain details refine the explanation; no exact glacier name is invented.
proposals.name: Glacial-collapse and terrain reconstruction of the Nepal-Tibet flood

proposals.definition: The common Wednesday 26 August 2026 collapse/debris-flow and cross-border flood identified by the read originals. Supports both causal and impact strands; updated casualty measurements are not new flood occurrences, and shared occurrence is not an article-duplicate judgment.
proposals.name: The 26 August Nepal-Tibet collapse and flash flood

proposals.definition: The NT parliamentary process adopting voluntary assisted dying legislation to align with other Australian jurisdictions, bounded by the territory and specific end-of-life bill rather than all Australian health law.
proposals.name: Northern Territory's assisted-dying legislative process

proposals.definition: Parliamentary passage, near-unanimous support, rejected amendments and the national legislative-coverage implication. Passage alone does not establish commencement or immediate patient access.
proposals.name: NT assisted-dying bill passage by conscience vote

proposals.definition: The specific reported conscience vote passing the NT bill; not an asserted royal-assent, service commencement or first patient-access occurrence.
proposals.name: NT Parliament passes its assisted-dying bill

proposals.definition: The reported RFK Jr. 2019 Samoa visit, contacts concerning MMR and later scrutiny of his account as a US public official. The title/summary identify Samoa; the URL american-samoa token remains an unresolved territorial issue, not authorization to switch jurisdictions or prove outbreak causation.
proposals.name: Kennedy's reported 2019 Samoa vaccine engagement and later scrutiny

proposals.definition: The documentary-accountability strand comparing a reported MMR-assessment letter with Kennedy's testimony and HHS denial, with outbreak/confirmation-policy concerns as attributed context. The blocked original prevents territorial/documentary verification; no dishonesty or outbreak causation is certified.
proposals.name: Samoa letter challenges Kennedy's vaccine-unrelated account

proposals.definition: The identified Nchimbi resignation, CCM disciplinary expulsion and Ndejembi replacement nomination. A coherent office/party transition, separate from the October election and violence inquiry despite analysts' suggested connection.
proposals.name: Nchimbi's exit and CCM discipline/succession process

proposals.definition: The current departure/succession strand linking resignation, claimed-indiscipline expulsion and Migiro's replacement nomination. Linked steps do not become separate Stories for each official.
proposals.name: Nchimbi resignation, expulsion and replacement nomination

proposals.definition: The specific CCM expulsion of Emmanuel Nchimbi after resignation; indiscipline is attributed and no disciplinary meeting date is inferred.
proposals.name: CCM expels Nchimbi after resignation

proposals.definition: The identified contentious October election associated with Samia Suluhu Hassan and subsequent violence/postelection inquiry. The summary does not give the election year, which is not silently supplied. Separate from Nchimbi's later office/party rupture.
proposals.name: Tanzania's contentious October election and violent aftermath

proposals.definition: The inquiry-findings strand reporting 518 deaths in postelection violence and the commission leader's warning the number may be higher. Not a verified final count or proof it caused Nchimbi's departure.
proposals.name: Tanzanian postelection inquiry reports lethal violence

proposals.definition: The Saxony-Anhalt state election scheduled for September 6 in the August 2026 report, including AfD polling, proposed restrictions and resident responses. Not federal/other state elections or an enacted deportation programme.
proposals.name: September 2026 Saxony-Anhalt state election

proposals.definition: The pre-election strand linking AfD over-40% polling and restrictive immigration proposals to safety/belonging concerns, uncertainty about staying and continued civic engagement amid racism. Demographics provide context; polling is not a win or enacted policy.
proposals.name: Migrant concerns and civic response to AfD's advance

proposals.definition: The Israel-Hamas Gaza war and military violence/civilian consequences, including continuing violence under the reported ceasefire: the full meaning and existing literal parents of catalog event-45b4b05d6c7612d7d70bcc473dfd375b33934788ac9a760e061f774c244e0008. This explicit extension requests legal-accountability, humanitarian-relief and interstate-response parents evidenced by the WCK convoy attack and Australian investigation demands. Not a new war, silent alias change or inclusion of Iran/West Bank events.
proposals.name: The Gaza war with explicit aid-convoy accountability parents

proposals.definition: The connected accountability strand: Mendel's defense, IDF misidentification finding/dismissal/no-prosecution decision, WCK denial of Hamas ties and Frankcom family/Australian demands for independent inquiry. Responses address the same attack, not unrelated cases; disputed Hamas ties are not accepted as fact.
proposals.name: Accountability dispute over the April 2024 WCK convoy strike

proposals.definition: The identified April 2024 aid-convoy drone strike killing seven workers, distinct from later interview, dismissal and no-prosecution decision. No exact day is supplied by the summary.
proposals.name: April 2024 strike killing Frankcom and six other WCK workers

proposals.definition: The positively identified Australian under-16 access-ban regime, implementation and official defense as child protection, separate from the US Meta case even where officials cite its settlement. The blocked original leaves rollout timing unverified; no exact law name or commencement date is invented.
proposals.name: Australia's under-16 social-media ban and implementation

proposals.definition: The supported reported national-policy strand describing the implemented under-16 ban and officials' claim that Meta restrictions show protective capacity. Does not imply adoption of the US agreement or a single worldwide government Event; implementation timing/extent await accessible original evidence.
proposals.name: Australia's access-ban implementation and case for child safeguards

proposals.definition: The identified Wednesday northeastern Algeria fire emergency, reported in late August 2026 with 69 blazes, casualties, wind and evacuations. Not all Algerian summer fires or unrelated Algerian reforms; climate vulnerability is attributed, not a verified attribution study.
proposals.name: Northeastern Algeria August 2026 wildfire emergency

proposals.definition: The connected emergency-response strand: revised 12-death toll, injuries, evacuation, firefighting and government statements about more severe/frequent climate-related summer fires. Updated count, wind and vulnerability do not automatically create different Stories.
proposals.name: Wildfire casualties, firefighting and attributed vulnerability

proposals.definition: Physical computing facilities, power provisioning and operating efficiency for large-scale AI workloads. Software power controls belong here when their purpose is facility capacity or energy use; unrelated NVIDIA products do not.
proposals.name: AI factory infrastructure and power efficiency

proposals.definition: Research partnerships and agent systems that learn from, understand or act in video-game environments. Cloud delivery of ordinary games is a separate subject.
proposals.name: AI agents and research in video games

proposals.definition: Learning representations and predicting attributes of places using geographic, descriptive and mobility data. Aggregate place dynamics, rather than individual movement tracking, are the subject of this evidence.
proposals.name: Geospatial machine learning

proposals.definition: Empirical work on how training data, memorization, learned shortcuts and causal attribution affect model capabilities or the validity of evaluations. Sharing this topic does not make independent studies one Event.
proposals.name: AI capability provenance and evaluation reliability

proposals.definition: AI-enabled cyber attacks, security failures during model development, containment and defensive safeguards. General model performance or safety statements without a cyber connection are outside this topic.
proposals.name: AI cybersecurity and model containment

proposals.definition: Policy proposals, deployment requirements and research-pause campaigns intended to manage frontier-model and superintelligence risks. This is not itself an Event, nor does it imply that separate proposals are one policy action.
proposals.name: Frontier AI safety governance

proposals.definition: Development, training and evaluation of systems that transcribe speech, including multilingual and code-switching speech. Benchmark contamination and improved training methods remain distinct research Events.
proposals.name: Automatic speech recognition research

proposals.definition: Private endpoints, inbound access policy and network isolation for cloud service resources. Merely offering AI applications on the same platform is not evidence of an employee AI adoption rollout.
proposals.name: Cloud-platform private networking and access control

proposals.definition: Computational prediction of chemical reactions, molecular properties and catalytic materials, including density functional theory and learned physical functionals. Independent catalyst and functional projects are not one Event.
proposals.name: Computational chemistry and materials modeling

proposals.definition: Research into chemical production routes that reduce fossil-fuel use, emissions or energy inputs. Here the substantive application is lower-energy electrochemical ammonia production for fertilizer.
proposals.name: Sustainable chemical production

proposals.definition: Techniques that make model inference faster or compatible with a target execution stack, including speculative decoding and operation adapters. Common hardware or libraries alone do not identify a shared Event.
proposals.name: AI inference optimization and hardware enablement

proposals.definition: Remote streaming of PC games, supported client platforms and service access. GPU branding does not place these updates in AI factory infrastructure.
proposals.name: Cloud gaming services

proposals.definition: AI systems that find, navigate and verify information within documents or across sources, including iterative retrieval tools and evaluations. Model availability alone is not a retrieval project.
proposals.name: AI document retrieval and evidence navigation

proposals.definition: Methods for transferring knowledge between languages and training models for low-resource languages. Written-language pretraining and speech transcription can share a language context without sharing an Event.
proposals.name: Multilingual language-model learning

proposals.definition: Engineering quantum processors and their supporting infrastructure for scalable and fault-tolerant computation, including cryogenics and multi-chip connections. IBM AI accelerator work is not this topic.
proposals.name: Quantum computing systems and scalability

proposals.definition: Questions about attribution, ownership and use of creative training material in generative AI. A scientific finding with legal implications does not establish a particular lawsuit or legal ruling.
proposals.name: Generative AI authorship and copyright

proposals.definition: Development, release and measured capabilities of general-purpose AI models used for coding, document work and assistant workflows. A product capability report does not establish a specific employer adoption program.
proposals.name: General-purpose AI model development and releases

proposals.definition: The named DSX MaxLPS effort to optimize AI factory power use across chip, cooling, system and software layers. Its dynamic-power strand is included; a separate deal to secure an Ohio site is not the same Event just because both use DSX.
proposals.name: NVIDIA DSX MaxLPS AI factory power-optimization program

proposals.definition: The MaxLPS strand replacing static peak rack provisioning with monitored redistribution of unused GPU power headroom. Capacity gains, workload profiles and liquid-cooling efficiency support the same operating-efficiency account rather than independent Stories.
proposals.name: Dynamic power allocation increases usable AI factory capacity

proposals.definition: The named SIMA research program developing agents that understand language and act through ordinary game controls, including Gemini-powered SIMA 2 and studio research environments. Earlier AlphaGo, Atari and AlphaStar milestones are background, not this Event.
proposals.name: Google DeepMind SIMA generalist gaming-agent research

proposals.definition: The SIMA strand using partner games to develop general agents, interactive companions and adaptive NPC capabilities without game-code modifications. The source identifies SIMA 2 and examples including No Man's Sky, Valheim and Hydroneer; speculative applications are not asserted as shipped products.
proposals.name: Studio-backed SIMA agents for adaptable gameplay and companions

proposals.definition: The specifically named research partnership between Google DeepMind and Fenris Creations involving the EVE Universe. The original source says it was unveiled earlier in 2026; this is not a newly inferred August signing or a merger of all studio partnerships.
proposals.name: Google DeepMind and Fenris Creations EVE research partnership

proposals.definition: Discussion of the Fenris/EVE collaboration as part of DeepMind's current effort to prototype gameplay experiences and expand game-based research. This strand does not claim that EVE already contains a released SIMA integration.
proposals.name: EVE collaboration as a platform for new AI gameplay research

proposals.definition: The ME-POIs framework research combining textual place metadata with anonymized mobility activity to represent places and predict their attributes. Named framework identity, rather than a common publisher or publication date, bounds this Event.
proposals.name: Google Mobility-Embedded POIs research

proposals.definition: The ME-POIs strand aligning mobility rhythms and text to predict opening hours, price levels and busyness, with propagation to sparsely visited places. Los Angeles and Houston results are evidence for the same framework, not separate city Events.
proposals.name: Mobility-text fusion improves place predictions and sparse-place coverage

proposals.definition: Glenn Matlin and Chandreyi Chakraborty's study tracing Olmo 3 social reasoning to categories of training data using open artifacts and benchmark ablations. This is distinct from the drug-name morphology study despite the same Olmo 3 stack.
proposals.name: Georgia Tech Olmo 3 social-reasoning attribution study

proposals.definition: The study's finding that narrative and interpersonal training categories affect social-reasoning benchmarks more than expository data, supported by removing categories. Open-source auditability enables this finding and is not a separate Olmo model launch.
proposals.name: Narrative and interpersonal data drive measured social reasoning

proposals.definition: OpenAI's response to frontier-model cyber capabilities and training-agent containment failures reported in August 2026. The original report links the late-July Hugging Face breach, Astra capability concerns and the training pause. This does not merge incidents at Meta or Anthropic into OpenAI's Event.
proposals.name: OpenAI August 2026 frontier-model cyber-safety response

proposals.definition: OpenAI's pause of some frontier-model training for new safeguards and Chris Lehane's explanation of persistent attack risks from advancing models. The containment failure explains the response; unrelated company listings do not make another cyber Story.
proposals.name: Training safeguards and warning about persistent AI cyber attacks

proposals.definition: The concrete US policy debate over voluntary or mandatory frontier-model testing and pre-deployment safety standards discussed in the report, including the June executive-order context and Lehane's legislative proposal. This does not mean a law has passed.
proposals.name: US frontier-model pre-deployment safety standards debate in 2026

proposals.definition: Chris Lehane's proposed US law requiring safety standards and evidence before frontier-model release, with pauses built into the process and possible international coordination. This policy strand is distinct from OpenAI's already announced internal training pause.
proposals.name: Lehane calls for mandatory safety proofs and built-in pauses

proposals.definition: The AI Futures Project's reported campaign for governments to postpone superintelligence beyond the organization's projected 2030 arrival, allowing another decade for safety work. This is an advocacy campaign, not an enacted pause or an OpenAI internal program.
proposals.name: AI Futures Project campaign to delay superintelligence

proposals.definition: The campaign's argument, explained by Daniel Kokotajlo, that rapid capability growth and an uncontrolled intelligence explosion justify postponement. The source supplies the campaign identity missing from the stored summary's generic reference to safety experts.
proposals.name: Safety campaigners argue for delay to prevent uncontrolled intelligence growth

proposals.definition: The reported evaluation of 11 open ASR models for benchmark-associated behavior on VoxPopuli and LibriSpeech using disagreement and orthographic probes. Neither the same speech task nor open-source status links it to the Mandarin-English training study.
proposals.name: Eleven-model ASR benchmark-optimization study

proposals.definition: The finding that high-scoring ASR systems sometimes follow benchmark transcripts rather than the actual audio, with dataset-associated acoustic cues and probe results supporting evaluation concerns. Held-out testing is a consequence of this finding, not a separate study.
proposals.name: Benchmark acoustic cues cause transcript reproduction despite contradictory audio

proposals.definition: The named extension of Databricks Inbound Private Link from workspace access to account-level resources and stable/custom URLs. It is not the catalog's Databricks frontier-model employee rollout; the company name and Genie mention do not establish that identity.
proposals.name: Databricks Inbound Private Link account-scope expansion

proposals.definition: The extension securing Genie One, the account console and custom or disaster-recovery URLs through private endpoints, with context-based ingress policy. These are connected capabilities in the same networking update, not separate Stories for each URL.
proposals.name: Private endpoints cover account resources and custom URLs

proposals.definition: The reported availability of the account-resource and URL extension in Beta on AWS Enterprise and Azure Premium. The stored publication timestamp is not asserted to be the exact moment the beta began.
proposals.name: Account-scope Inbound Private Link beta availability

proposals.definition: Bilge Yildiz, Constantine Athanitis and Filip Grajkowski's EES Catalysis research predicting catalyst materials for lower-energy electrochemical ammonia production. The named team, reaction and publication identify the project; MIT affiliation alone does not.
proposals.name: MIT computational catalyst study for electrochemical ammonia synthesis

proposals.definition: The computational method for finding catalysts that lower energy requirements and suppress side reactions in electrochemical ammonia synthesis. Its fertilizer and emissions implications are substantive, but the article does not establish a working industrial process.
proposals.name: Theoretical catalyst screening targets greener ammonia production

proposals.definition: Efficient inference development for the named Liquid AI LFM2.5 model family, including DSpark draft-model decoding. Results across hardware and model sizes are part of this program, not separate Events for each device.
proposals.name: Liquid AI LFM2.5 efficient-inference development

proposals.definition: The DSpark strand using draft tokens and confidence-based verification to reduce latency, with reported H100 and MacBook Pro gains and llama.cpp/SGLang integration. Speed comparisons and deployment instructions support this same strand.
proposals.name: DSpark speculative decoding accelerates LFM2.5 inference

proposals.definition: The introduction of LFM2.5-DSpark with checkpoints on Hugging Face and open implementations supporting llama.cpp and SGLang. This occurrence does not claim that all larger models achieve the reported maximum speedup.
proposals.name: LFM2.5-DSpark checkpoint and implementation release

proposals.definition: Development and computational-chemistry integration of Microsoft's named Skala exchange-correlation functional for density functional theory. Its version and benchmark work belong to this program, not the unrelated MIT ammonia catalyst project.
proposals.name: Microsoft Research Skala learned DFT functional development

proposals.definition: The Skala 1.1 update trained on more data, with improved thermochemical and kinetic results, CP2K availability, planned additional integrations and a living benchmark. The benchmark and package integrations explain the release rather than forming independent Stories.
proposals.name: Skala 1.1 improves molecular accuracy and software access

proposals.definition: The reported release of version 1.1 and its availability in CP2K. Integration into Psi4, FHI-aims, ORCA and VASP is described as in progress, not as completed at this occurrence.
proposals.name: Skala 1.1 release with CP2K availability

proposals.definition: The specific effort to run Hugging Face Transformer models on IBM's emerging Spyre accelerator software stack while its compiler and runtime mature. AI-written compatibility work identifies this effort; IBM quantum cryogenics is unrelated.
proposals.name: IBM Spyre Transformer-model enablement effort

proposals.definition: AI agents inspect model logic and compiler constraints to produce runtime patches that translate operations without changing the model's mathematics. The temporary adapters and scalable coverage of model architectures are one enablement approach, not separate model releases.
proposals.name: AI-written runtime adapters enable models before stack maturity

proposals.definition: Expansion of browser access to the named GeForce NOW cloud gaming service, which already supports Chrome, Edge and Opera. This event is bounded by service client compatibility, not all NVIDIA announcements.
proposals.name: GeForce NOW desktop-browser support expansion

proposals.definition: The Firefox compatibility strand providing app-free cloud game access, including Ultimate-member streaming limits. Gallipoli availability is mentioned as a supporting weekly-update detail, not sufficient evidence for a separately defined game-launch Event.
proposals.name: Firefox access brings GeForce NOW streaming to another Windows browser

proposals.definition: The reported addition of Firefox on Windows as a supported GeForce NOW streaming client. This is a service-compatibility occurrence, not a consumer-device launch.
proposals.name: Firefox on Windows added to GeForce NOW browser support

proposals.definition: Development and availability of the named Mistral Agentic Search system through Search Toolkit and Libraries. Its multi-step document access and verification, rather than a shared AI vendor or generic agent label, identify the Event.
proposals.name: Mistral Agentic Search development and toolkit rollout

proposals.definition: The Agentic Search strand using search, open, navigate, read and grep tools to refine evidence retrieval, with results on financial filings and table-heavy documents and lower latency/token use. Sensitive-data support and toolkit availability describe this approach rather than a proven enterprise adoption rollout.
proposals.name: Iterative document navigation improves retrieval accuracy and efficiency

proposals.definition: The named LINK research using bilingual lexical substitutions during language-model pretraining to improve low-resource-language knowledge transfer. The original source distinguishes modifying pretraining data from adding another training stage.
proposals.name: LINK lexical-intervention cross-lingual learning research

proposals.definition: LINK's substitution of selected English training words with translated equivalents, improving target-language tasks across eight languages and reaching equivalent performance with less training. The speedup does not mean that an untrained model acquires these capabilities without pretraining.
proposals.name: Bilingual word substitutions improve low-resource knowledge transfer

proposals.definition: The reported National University of Singapore and Apple study improving Mandarin-English code-switching recognition through iterative pseudo-labeling and bilingual training, evaluated on SEAME. Sharing Apple affiliation with LINK is not a shared research Event.
proposals.name: NUS and Apple Mandarin-English code-switching ASR study

proposals.definition: The study's three-phase approach generating pseudo-labels from unlabeled speech, conducting two-stage bilingual training and refining labels iteratively, with Mix Error Rate reductions on devman and devsge. Training phases and evaluation subsets do not independently establish additional Stories.
proposals.name: Iterative pseudo-label refinement improves bilingual transcription

proposals.definition: IBM's concrete roadmap toward scalable interconnected quantum systems and the planned Quantum Starling fault-tolerant system. The article explicitly places modular cryogenics within this roadmap; it does not report Starling as completed.
proposals.name: IBM fault-tolerant multi-chip quantum-computing roadmap

proposals.definition: The roadmap's infrastructure strand using separately cooled modular cryogenic cells with increased wiring and chamber space, connected through quantum and classical links. Heat, crosstalk, maintenance and upgrades are related engineering constraints, not separate Events.
proposals.name: Modular cryogenic cells support interconnected quantum processors

proposals.definition: The reported demonstration connecting two cryogenic cells to validate the modular approach. It is a prototype milestone and does not establish operation of a large fault-tolerant machine.
proposals.name: Two coupled cryogenic cells demonstrate modular architecture

proposals.definition: The MIT study using a diffusion-ensemble architecture to test causal influence of individual images or artists' training data as dataset size increases. The same study supplies scientific provenance findings and authorship implications, without identifying a separate copyright case.
proposals.name: MIT diffusion-ensemble attribution-decay study

proposals.definition: The attribution-decay finding that removing access to individual images or an artist's work can leave outputs unchanged as training sets grow. The architecture permits this test without full retraining; copyright and authorship questions follow from the finding rather than a legal decision.
proposals.name: Larger training sets weaken causal attribution of generated images

proposals.definition: The reported study tracing Olmo 3 drug responses to name affixes versus drug-specific learned facts, including behavior on rarer drugs. It is a distinct investigation from the Georgia Tech social-reasoning study; a common open model is not enough to merge them.
proposals.name: Olmo 3 drug-name morphology and knowledge study

proposals.definition: The study's finding that some drug answers are driven by suffixes such as -pril and many answers show no drug-specific knowledge, with rarer drugs more prone to affix-based generalization. Medical risk is a consequence of this model-behavior result, not evidence of a clinical deployment or patient incident.
proposals.name: Drug-name affixes substitute for drug-specific model knowledge

proposals.definition: Development of the PORTS-Pike Technology Campus AI factory capacity in Portsmouth, Ohio, with NVIDIA securing land/power/shell capacity with SB Energy and OpenAI as builder, operator and tenant. The named site and arrangement distinguish it from DSX MaxLPS optimization.
proposals.name: PORTS-Pike NVIDIA compute and OpenAI AI factory project

proposals.definition: The project strand securing an initial 4.25 GW site deployment with defined NVIDIA support for lease/power payments over 20 years and potential additional 3.75 GW. The source clarifies that the latter is remaining extra capacity, not a smaller replacement total. Redeployment and upgrade cycles explain the same long-lived commitment.
proposals.name: Long-term site and power commitments secure PORTS-Pike compute capacity

proposals.definition: NVIDIA's announcement of the SB Energy capacity arrangement at PORTS-Pike with OpenAI as tenant and initial 4.25 GW deployment planned. It is not an occurrence of those data centers entering service; the source describes future phased service in 2028-2030.
proposals.name: Announcement of PORTS-Pike capacity and infrastructure support arrangement

proposals.definition: Development and release of the named Gemini Flash model line, including the transition from 3.6 Flash to 3.7 Flash described here. The shared Google publisher does not connect this Event to ME-POIs or SIMA research.
proposals.name: Google Gemini Flash model development

proposals.definition: The version 3.7 Flash strand reporting improved debugging, web development, document processing and tool-driven knowledge work, with release pricing, availability and planned Gemini Spark use. Safety improvements and price are supporting release details, not independent policy or commercial Events.
proposals.name: Gemini 3.7 Flash coding and knowledge-work upgrade

proposals.definition: The reported launch of Gemini 3.7 Flash with the stated token pricing and availability through the end of the year. This does not establish a separate launch date for Gemini Spark or an employer-wide deployment.
proposals.name: Introduction of Gemini 3.7 Flash

proposals.definition: Jo Hooper's connected burnout, recovery and transition from communications employment to a self-directed business. This is a personal recovery-and-work-change process, not all burnout cases or a particular article's publication.
proposals.name: Jo Hooper's burnout recovery and redesign of working life

proposals.definition: Hooper's recovery account and prevention argument: perfectionism and repeated expectations sustain burnout, rest alone is insufficient, and control of workload and less work change the conditions. WHO classification and expert views explain this strand rather than establish a separate medical study.
proposals.name: Changing workload and expectations rather than only changing jobs

proposals.definition: The connected bond-market repricing described in 2026 across the United States, Germany, Japan and Britain, with inflation and public-debt concerns compounded by the current hyperscaler debt-issuance wave. Its boundary is this cross-market selloff and its financing drivers, not all bond history or a daily article release.
proposals.name: Advanced-economy bond selloff and connected AI borrowing pressure

proposals.definition: Multi-decade sovereign-yield highs, associated household and government financing costs, and the debt-or-growth adjustments needed for durable relief in the identified selloff. Country yield examples and Britain's interest bill support this common repricing strand rather than separate country Events.
proposals.name: Higher sovereign yields raise funding costs and expose fiscal constraints

proposals.definition: The five major AI hyperscalers' reported $220 billion issuance wave and its contribution to $4.9 trillion global corporate issuance and upward financing pressure. It is the connected debt-supply strand, not an inferred single-company offering or model launch.
proposals.name: AI hyperscaler borrowing adds to record corporate bond supply

proposals.definition: Lexaria Bioscience's Australian research-and-development tax-incentive claim and receipt of the identified $2.6 million rebate, including its direct financing and market response. This is not a general biotechnology research programme or all Australian tax rebates.
proposals.name: Lexaria's Australian R&D tax-rebate funding process

proposals.definition: Receipt and account deposit of Lexaria's $2.6 million Australian Tax Office R&D rebate and the reported early-trading share response. Deposit and share reaction are one funding-update strand, not separate market and research Stories.
proposals.name: The $2.6 million rebate is deposited and shares rise

proposals.definition: The account deposit of the $2.6 million R&D rebate reported by Lexaria. The frozen row does not specify the exact deposit date; September 1 is the reporting metadata, not an invented transaction time.
proposals.name: Deposit of Lexaria's $2.6 million Australian R&D rebate

proposals.definition: The continuing reserve-diversification and trade de-dollarisation process evidenced by the dollar's falling reserve share since 2000 and confidence pressures under Trump, alongside persistent dollar-based financial flows. Its boundary is this observed international monetary shift, not every currency study or any article publication.
proposals.name: The continuing erosion of dollar reserve dominance and limited de-dollarisation

proposals.definition: The argument that reserve diversification and weaker trust reduce dollar dominance while financial intermediation remains dollar-centered and neither the euro nor renminbi can yet replace it. Sundaram's and Eichengreen's accounts jointly support this strand rather than separate speaker Events.

proposals.definition: Chris Malone's departure as OpenAI data-centres chief in the context of other 2026 senior exits and company statements about established leadership and normal turnover. Other cited departures support this wave, not separate inventions of resignations or IPO completion.
proposals.name: Infrastructure leadership departure amid OpenAI's executive-exit wave

proposals.definition: The US public and political backlash in 2026 against AI data-centre expansion, especially water demand, as it enters state-level and midterm campaigning. It is distinct from OpenAI's personnel transition, Britain's drought and the catalog's specifically House-focused election Event.
proposals.name: US political and community opposition to AI data-centre expansion in 2026

proposals.definition: Water-related opposition to US AI data centres and its electoral salience, including the NRSC warning about spread beyond Ohio and Sherrod Brown's campaign opposition. It does not assert a House race, enactment of a water rule or cancellation of a particular facility.
proposals.name: Water-use objections turn AI data centres into a midterm campaign issue

proposals.definition: The Indian national population census associated with the 2027 demographic baseline, including its collection design, execution and data-quality risks. It is not the 2011 census, a state caste survey, a completed delimitation exercise or all governmental digitization.
proposals.name: India's 2027 population census exercise

proposals.definition: The move to mobile capture and optional self-enumeration, direct server entry and real-time monitoring together with 31 updated questions on contemporary household assets, balanced against field-device and enumerator-literacy risks. These are parts of one operational modernization strand.
proposals.name: Digital enumeration and the revised census questionnaire

proposals.definition: The argument that household-level digital census information lets the Centre target and expand direct welfare programmes over state and local responsibilities. This administrative-autonomy strand is distinct from the inter-state distribution of financial shares and is a forecast, not a completed takeover.
proposals.name: Granular census data may shift welfare administration from states to the Centre

proposals.definition: The reported August 2026 block transaction in Physicswallah shares valued at approximately Rs 550 crore at Rs 117.72 per share and its associated trading response. It excludes other shareholders' trades and the separate Q1FY27 results process.
proposals.name: Physicswallah's reported August 2026 Rs 550 crore block trade

proposals.definition: The market reaction to the reported Rs 550 crore block trade, with shares rising around 5% toward Rs 126.98 despite the block price being below the prior close. The six-month recovery is historical price context, not a new transaction.
proposals.name: Physicswallah shares rise after the discounted block transaction

proposals.definition: The single reported block transaction at Rs 117.72 per share in the August 26, 2026 report. No purchaser, seller, precise execution timestamp or second transaction is inferred.
proposals.name: The reported Rs 550 crore Physicswallah block transaction

proposals.definition: Physicswallah's results for the first quarter of financial year 2027 and the investment assessment based on that quarter's performance. This quarter-specific process is not the same Event as the block transaction or all future Physicswallah earnings.
proposals.name: Physicswallah's Q1FY27 financial-results and outlook assessment

proposals.definition: The quarter's Rs 88.3 crore net loss, revenue of Rs 1,054 crore with 24% growth, and a monetization/profitability-based positive investment assessment, including the cited JM Financial Buy upgrade. The upgrade is part of this reported outlook, not proof of another independently dated research occurrence.
proposals.name: Narrower losses and revenue growth support Physicswallah's profitability outlook

proposals.definition: Public interpretation and circulation of the specific maxim attributed to Dolly Parton warning against being so busy making a living that one forgets to make a life. Its stable subject is this identifiable advice, not every Parton quotation, musical work or a new speaking appearance.
proposals.name: Dolly Parton's making-a-living versus making-a-life maxim and its interpretation

proposals.definition: Interpretation of the maxim as a deliberate choice to preserve relationships and meaningful experiences while using earned income to support life rather than supplant it. This is practical life advice, not evidence of a new clinical intervention or employment rule.
proposals.name: Protect time for relationships and joy instead of letting work replace life

proposals.definition: The public controversy over Giva's 2026 Raksha Bandhan advertisement featuring Kriti Sanon, including clothing/cultural criticism, women's-choice responses, political reactions and brand withdrawal. It is not all Rakhi activity, another withdrawn advertisement or Instamart's sales programme.
proposals.name: Giva's 2026 Kriti Sanon Raksha Bandhan advertisement controversy

proposals.definition: The connected dispute over Sanon's outfit, her defence of emotional rather than clothing-based tradition, Gandhi's women's-choice response, Ranaut's criticism and the advertisement's withdrawal. These are responses within the same freedom-versus-cultural-norms strand, not one Story per speaker.
proposals.name: Women's clothing choice versus festival authenticity in the Giva ad backlash

proposals.definition: Giva Jewellery's Wednesday, August 26, 2026 withdrawal of the Kriti Sanon Raksha Bandhan advertisement amid the backlash. This does not identify the ad's initial release or an unrelated brand withdrawal.
proposals.name: Giva withdraws the Raksha Bandhan advertisement on August 26

proposals.definition: Instamart's 2026 Raksha Bandhan gifting assortment, promotion and associated demand assessment. It is bounded by this platform, season and retail activity, not all jewellery sales or the Giva advertisement dispute.
proposals.name: Instamart's Raksha Bandhan 2026 gifting-retail programme

proposals.definition: The reported twenty-fold increase in Instamart premium Rakhi demand, regional take-up, curated jewellery-brand offerings and promotional support. The projected three-fold gifting growth is a forecast within this retail strategy, not a completed growth measurement.
proposals.name: Premium Rakhi demand shifts toward silver and jewellery-inspired gifts

proposals.definition: The reported June 2026 Jaipur attack on CJP founder Abhijeet Dipke before a protest address and the ensuing political allegations. It excludes the later attack on Ashutosh Ranka's school-inspection team and any hypothetical attack on Saurav Das.
proposals.name: Alleged June 2026 Jaipur assault on Abhijeet Dipke

proposals.definition: Dipke's account of the assault and his allegation of RSS involvement, subsequently recalled in a joint interview. The allegation is attributed, not an established judicial finding about the assailants.
proposals.name: Dipke attributes his Jaipur assault to alleged RSS participants

proposals.definition: The June 2026 Jaipur assault recalled in the August report, before Dipke addressed protesters. No precise June day or time is supported.
proposals.name: Reported June Jaipur assault on Dipke before his address

proposals.definition: The reported attack on Ashutosh Ranka and CJP volunteers on their way to inspect a government school in Jaipur's Bagru constituency in the week before the August 26 report, and the disputed political responsibility. It is distinct from Dipke's June incident.
proposals.name: Alleged August 2026 Jaipur attack on Ranka's CJP team

proposals.definition: Ranka's claim that BJP workers attacked the school-inspection team and fractured a volunteer's arm, and the BJP's counterclaim about Congress-linked CJP activity. Competing allegations are not converted into proven responsibility.
proposals.name: Ranka alleges BJP-linked assault and a volunteer injury while the BJP disputes responsibility

proposals.definition: The particular attack on Ranka's travelling team described as occurring last week in the August 26, 2026 report. Its exact day remains unspecified rather than being reconstructed from the relative phrase.
proposals.name: The alleged Bagru school-inspection team attack

proposals.definition: The announcement of a 100% US tariff on branded or patented pharmaceutical imports effective October 1, 2025, with an exception for companies building US manufacturing plants, and its immediate market consequences. It is not a 2026 tariff episode or the India-US bilateral negotiating process in the catalog.
proposals.name: Trump's September 2025 branded-pharmaceutical import-tariff announcement

proposals.definition: The September 26, 2025 Indian benchmark and pharmaceutical-share sell-off as investors reassess export/earnings exposure to the announced drug tariff. It includes the sixth-session decline and broader stock/foreign-investor context without conflating it with August 2026 trading.
proposals.name: Indian equity and pharmaceutical shares sell off after the new drug-tariff announcement

proposals.definition: The Friday September 26, 2025 session in which Sensex and Nifty fell about 0.90% and 0.95%, respectively, as established by the original publication. The frozen August 26, 2026 source timestamp is not the session date.
proposals.name: September 26, 2025 Sensex and Nifty closing sell-off

proposals.definition: The US H-1B visa-fee increase described as recent in the original September 26, 2025 market report, and the associated business/market reassessment. This is that fee-policy shock, not every H-1B rule or an individually adjudicated visa case.
proposals.name: The September 2025 US H-1B visa-fee increase and business response

proposals.definition: The reported selling of Indian IT counters and reassessment of earnings/export prospects following the H-1B visa-fee hike during the September 2025 market decline. The combined policy pressure is narrated alongside pharma tariffs but retains its own policy Event.
proposals.name: H-1B fee exposure pressures Indian IT shares and investor earnings expectations

proposals.definition: The transformation within the CJP-linked 2026 Jantar Mantar/nationwide agitation from individually experienced exam leaks and scarce jobs into collective demands for accountability, liberty and social justice. It describes the movement's political development, not a new examination investigation or the Amnesty policing-allegation strand.
proposals.name: Exam and job grievances develop into collective democratic mobilization

proposals.definition: The connected Indian benchmark recovery across the August 25, 2026 closing session and August 26 opening as crude prices retreat and expiry positioning supports late buying. It is distinct from September 2025 drug-tariff selling and from every oil-price or market fluctuation.
proposals.name: Indian equity recovery around August 25-26, 2026 amid lower crude prices

proposals.definition: The August 25 late-session Sensex/Nifty recovery driven by lower crude and expiry-day short covering, followed by a positive August 26 open. Sector performance supports this market strand rather than creating separate company or sector Events.
proposals.name: Lower energy costs and expiry buying lift benchmarks before a positive next-day open

proposals.definition: The Tuesday session closing at Sensex 77,656.09 (+0.37%) and Nifty 24,334.55 (+0.48%), correctly placed on August 25 by the original August 26 opening report. It is not the following day's close.
proposals.name: August 25, 2026 Indian benchmark closing recovery

proposals.definition: The Wednesday August 26 green opening reported after the prior day's recovery. The evidence gives no closing result for this Wednesday and no exact opening index values.
proposals.name: August 26, 2026 positive Sensex and Nifty opening

proposals.definition: Google Threat Intelligence Group's continuing assessment and defensive response to AI-enabled cyber attacks, including Shane Huntley's public account of model ecosystems, rapid protection and regulatory constraints. It excludes general model launches and the catalog's specifically OpenAI cyber-safety response.
proposals.name: Google Threat Intelligence Group's AI-enabled threat and defence response

proposals.definition: Huntley's argument that AI-enabled attackers using both open and closed models require rapid, adaptive defensive applications, good-faith vulnerability collaboration and regulation that preserves defenders' capability. Model plurality and balanced regulation explain this same attack/defence strategy, not separate releases or enacted laws.
proposals.name: Adaptive computer-speed defence against open- and closed-model cyber threats

proposals.definition: The proposed SpaceX Starship spaceport near Pecan Island, Louisiana, described as Starbase Louisiana, with approximately 125,000 acres and planned construction beginning in 2027. Its development includes launch/propellant/port infrastructure, regional economic commitments and coastal stewardship, not the separate Texas or Florida bases or all SpaceX activity.
proposals.name: SpaceX's Starbase Louisiana spaceport development

proposals.definition: The announcement of a roughly $100 billion Louisiana Starship launch complex, its planned facilities and orbital positioning, job commitments, wetland preservation and restoration. These linked siting and development terms constitute the project's announcement strand, not proof that construction or restoration has been completed.
proposals.name: SpaceX outlines the Louisiana launch complex and its economic and coastal commitments

proposals.definition: The NRC-Mithun programme characterizing the Arunachali/Siang-region mithun population, described by its director as Project Siangmi, including whole-genome population analysis, breed-recognition work and evidence-based breeding conservation. It is not the previously registered Nagami breed programme or all livestock research.
proposals.name: ICAR's Siangmi mithun characterization and genetic-conservation programme

proposals.definition: Whole-genome findings of moderate diversity/inbreeding and a declining effective breeding population near 160, with identification, parentage and combined genomic/phenotypic records proposed for conservation and productivity. The estimate is a genetic measure, not a claim that only 160 mithuns exist.
proposals.name: Genomic breeding-population decline calls for evidence-based mithun management

proposals.definition: Characterization of a connected but distinct Siang-region mithun population as the proposed Siangmi breed, and the case for formal breed recognition. It does not assert registration was completed or equate Siangmi with the registered Nagami breed.
proposals.name: Distinct Siang-region mithuns support a proposed Siangmi breed identity

proposals.definition: The MIT research effort developing CrysVCD to generate chemically viable crystalline materials by combining diffusion/language models with early valence constraints. It is distinct from MIT ammonia catalyst screening, learned DFT functionals and independent AI-materials projects.
proposals.name: MIT's CrysVCD valence-constrained generative-materials research

proposals.definition: CrysVCD's chemically constrained generation approach and reported stability/efficiency gains, including 68% mechanical stability and 85% metastability, with targeted thermal properties. Potential semiconductor/cooling applications are motivations, not evidence of separate manufacturing or data-centre deployments.
proposals.name: Early valence constraints improve stable and property-targeted material generation

proposals.definition: The identifiable data mesh architectural model's design and interpretation: domain-owned data products, self-service infrastructure and federated computational governance. This is the model-development line discussed comparatively, not one shared enterprise implementation, every decentralized database or a Databricks rollout.
proposals.name: Development of the data mesh domain-owned architecture model

proposals.definition: The data mesh account of domain responsibility and business context, using a shared lakehouse/governance substrate to preserve interoperability and coexist with fabric-style automation. It is not evidence of any named customer's organizational migration.
proposals.name: Domain-owned data products address organizational bottlenecks with shared governance

proposals.definition: The vendor-independent data fabric architectural model's design and interpretation: active metadata, automated integration and consistent governance across distributed systems. It is not Microsoft Fabric, a specific software release, the mesh ownership model or every data-platform project.
proposals.name: Development of the data fabric metadata-integration architecture model

proposals.definition: The fabric account of centralized metadata automation, cross-system integration and policy enforcement that can operate underneath mesh-style domain ownership on a lakehouse. Complementarity is the comparative conclusion, not proof that a particular organization adopted a hybrid.
proposals.name: Metadata-driven automation addresses technical fragmentation alongside domain ownership

proposals.definition: The Apache Iceberg software/table-format project and its metadata, snapshot, partition and commit-coordination design. It is not Apache Hudi, Delta Lake, the Parquet file format or every open-format implementation.
proposals.name: Apache Iceberg open table-format development

proposals.definition: Iceberg's metadata tree, manifests, snapshots/time travel and catalog-coordinated table state, including pruning and maintenance requirements. These are mechanisms of its table architecture, not an asserted new Iceberg release.
proposals.name: Iceberg's manifest and snapshot architecture enables consistent, efficiently queried tables

proposals.definition: The Delta Lake software/table-format project and its transaction-log, table-versioning and catalog-coordinated commit design. It is distinct from Apache Iceberg, Apache Hudi, Databricks governance essays and unrelated Databricks products.
proposals.name: Delta Lake open table-format development

proposals.definition: Delta Lake's ACID transaction log and evolving catalog commit coordination for consistency, table versioning and governance, with checkpoint/retention maintenance. It is an architecture strand, not evidence of a separately dated release in this stored summary.
proposals.name: Delta's transaction log and catalog commits govern concurrent table updates

proposals.definition: The Apache Hudi software/table-format project, including record-level indexing, upsert/delete operations and incremental high-frequency data processing. It is not Iceberg, Delta Lake or the data mesh ownership model.
proposals.name: Apache Hudi open table-format development

proposals.definition: Hudi's record indexes and update-oriented design for frequent upserts and consistent incremental table processing. Its contrast with manifest- and log-based alternatives explains one technical strand rather than proving a specific customer deployment.
proposals.name: Hudi's indexed record-level operations serve frequently changing data

proposals.definition: Planning, authorization, financing, construction and operation of wind generation at sea. Distinct named wind developments remain separate Events; neither a country nor renewable-energy aspirations identify a project.
proposals.name: Offshore wind power development

proposals.definition: Labor demand and supply, employment contractions, employer wage-setting power, worker-firm matching and their economic consequences. Different shocks, research projects and visa policies do not become one Event.
proposals.name: Labor markets, wage setting and employment shocks

proposals.definition: Differences in learning outcomes by race, household resources and other social disadvantages, and research into their causes. This is not restricted to gender inequality or educational admissions.
proposals.name: Educational achievement and social inequality

proposals.definition: Taxation of individuals' earnings, progressivity, optimal tax design and interactions with work incentives and the tax base. This is distinct from the catalog's taxes on businesses and commercial premises.
proposals.name: Personal income taxation and labor incentives

proposals.definition: Admission and employment of foreign workers, specialty-worker visa eligibility, visa fees, employer access and related legal authority. Separate visa regimes and legal cases require their own identities.
proposals.name: Employment immigration and skilled-worker visas

proposals.definition: Intended and desired childbearing, demographic fertility changes and the attitudes or social circumstances associated with them. Research into preferences does not imply a new family-support policy.
proposals.name: Fertility preferences and family demographic change

proposals.definition: Social expectations about maternal employment, parenthood, personal fulfillment and the division of family responsibilities, including differences across gender and education groups.
proposals.name: Gender roles, parental freedom and family life

proposals.definition: Prices, investment risks, trading services and custody of cryptocurrencies. A market rally, an exchange product programme and a stablecoin research conference are different Events.
proposals.name: Cryptocurrency markets and retail investment

proposals.definition: Stablecoins, tokenized financial assets, distributed ledgers and payment or settlement systems, including their substantive financial-market effects. Merely naming a cryptocurrency does not establish a payment-infrastructure strand.
proposals.name: Digital assets and payment infrastructure

proposals.definition: The international use of currencies, global intermediation, cross-border monetary flows and demand for reserve or safe assets. This is not central-bank interest-rate policy merely because a central banker speaks.
proposals.name: International monetary systems and reserve currencies

proposals.definition: Development of Pacifico Energy Korea's named Jindo Offshore Wind Project Cluster off Jindo County, including Myeong Ryang, Manho and Jindo Baram and the Integrated Cluster Phase 2 development process. The named cluster and developer supply the continuing project boundary; other South Korean wind projects and the proposed Honam semiconductor cluster are excluded. Reported capacity figures in the original do not reconcile and are not certified by this identity.
proposals.name: Pacifico Energy Korea's Jindo offshore wind project cluster

proposals.definition: The selection-and-development-authority strand identifying Pacifico Energy Korea as sole developer of Jindo Offshore Wind Integrated Cluster Phase 2 after the implementation-management agreement and developer evaluation. Manho and Jindo Baram are constituent developments, not independent new awards inferred from the article. This does not establish construction completion or electricity delivery.
proposals.name: Pacifico selected as sole developer of Jindo Integrated Cluster Phase 2

proposals.definition: Finno Exergy's named pressure-gain-combustion technology development for retrofitting industrial gas turbines, including Shell-assisted prototypes, transient feasibility simulations, scale-up and life-extension integration. This continuing technology programme is not all gas-turbine procurement or an unrelated Shell project.
proposals.name: Finno Exergy pressure-gain-combustion retrofit development

proposals.definition: The connected retrofit-method and validation strand using pulsating fast deflagration to gain pressure, retain existing turbomachinery and target fuel savings above 10 percent. Shell prototypes, the 2025 10 MW simulation and Frame 3/5 selection support the route toward an industrial demonstration; they do not prove full-scale commercial performance or create independent Stories for every test or component.
proposals.name: PGC retrofit efficiency case and validation route for existing turbines

proposals.definition: Development, validation and operation of Sage Geosystems' named SMECI enhanced-geothermal facility in South Texas. The site supplies a stable project boundary; a prospective Ormat Nevada development and other Sage sites remain different Events.
proposals.name: Sage Geosystems SMECI geothermal facility development and operation

proposals.definition: The extended operating-results strand assessing more than 120 days at SMECI, including subsurface performance, less-than-10-percent water loss, GeoTwin prediction and implications for scalable geothermal economics. The original says first electricity was sold in Q2 2026; this is not a newly verified August commissioning occurrence or a separate GeoTwin product launch.
proposals.name: SMECI operating campaign validates reservoir behavior and water retention

proposals.definition: Karla Cordova and Jessamyn Schaller's research identified by NBER w35639, Local Labor Demand and Achievement Gaps: Evidence from the Great Recession. The named study links local labor-demand contractions to children's test scores; it is not the whole Great Recession or another NBER paper issued on the same day.
proposals.name: Cordova-Schaller study of local labor demand and achievement gaps

proposals.definition: The study's connected finding that severe labor-demand contractions lower mathematics achievement and widen racial and economic-disadvantage gaps, with shift-share identification, ELA housing-bust qualifications and the post-2014 null. Funding, family income and house prices explain mechanisms or limits in this same findings strand.
proposals.name: Recession labor shocks reduce achievement and widen social gaps

proposals.definition: The research by David W. Berger, Kyle F. Herkenhoff, Jaehun Jeong and Simon Mongey identified by NBER w35640, Labor Market Power with Worker and Firm Heterogeneity. Its wage-setting and optimal-income-tax results are branches of one model and study, not a tax enactment or the distinct w35639 recession study.
proposals.name: Berger-Herkenhoff-Jeong-Mongey heterogeneous labor-market-power study

proposals.definition: The study's wage-setting strand incorporating discrete firm choice, production complementarities and strategic heterogeneous firms to explain labor-supply elasticities and markdowns. The original distinguishes 78 percent of the variable component from 89 percent of large-small-firm markdown differences.
proposals.name: Worker heterogeneity explains labor elasticity and employer wage markdowns

proposals.definition: The same study's income-tax-design strand in which progressivity reduces labor-supply elasticity, widens markdowns, worsens worker sorting and erodes earnings and the tax base, reducing optimal progressivity and associated welfare gains. These are modeled policy conclusions, not a government decision or realized tax change.
proposals.name: Heterogeneous labor market power changes optimal income-tax progressivity

proposals.definition: The specific policy process imposing the temporary $100,000 H-1B charge and proposing its replacement by a permanent $103,265 DHS fee in August 2026, with directly connected collection-authority challenges and employer response. This is a policy-level parent, not one merged lawsuit; enhanced vetting, visa selection reforms and separately added extension/transfer fees are not automatically the same measure.
proposals.name: Trump administration's 2025-2026 extraordinary H-1B fee regime

proposals.definition: The proposed-rule strand replacing the expiring extraordinary H-1B proclamation charge with a $103,265 fee and public comment before possible finalization, including employer recruitment costs and demand effects. It is not an enacted permanent fee.
proposals.name: DHS proposes a permanent $103,265 H-1B application fee

proposals.definition: The connected policy-authority strand contrasting challenges based on the H-1B statute and congressional revenue authority with the administration's entry-restriction argument, and reporting the temporary fee's collection bar and appeals. Different states', employers' and Chamber cases are not assigned a common case identity or a single ruling occurrence.
proposals.name: Legal contest over authority to impose and collect the extraordinary H-1B fee

proposals.definition: The identified Norway-EU Arctic drilling-policy disagreement discussed by Aasland and Opedal at the August 2026 ONS setting: continued development of Norwegian Barents Sea resources versus the EU's Arctic moratorium position and review amid European energy-security needs. This is a bounded policy dispute, not a single unnamed well, all Norway-EU relations or a merger with the Russia-Ukraine or Iran wars.
proposals.name: Norway-EU dispute over continued Barents Sea hydrocarbon development

proposals.definition: Norway's continuation-and-energy-security position in the Arctic-policy dispute, including its ice-free-area argument, European supply needs and producers' ability to sell oil/LNG elsewhere. Total's prospective exploration expansion illustrates the industry response, not a specified new drilling award.
proposals.name: Norway defends continued Arctic development while Europe reviews its ban

proposals.definition: The follow-on US tariff-threat strand in the August 2026 Canada negotiation escalation, including Trump's renewed threats concerning cars, trucks, auto parts and steel and the Canadian political response. The original reports a proposed January 1 start; this does not establish implementation or certify the threat as an enacted tariff schedule.
proposals.name: Trump threatens further sectoral tariffs after the Canada talks collapse

proposals.definition: The collective player intervention circulated by Mikaël Silvestre, Lucy Bronze, David James, Emmanuel Petit and others after Infantino's aborted World Cup stake-sale proposal, demanding leadership change and direct player/fan representation. This is distinct from the Nordic associations' confidence withdrawal and the CFU appearance dispute; headline pressure to resign is not proof of a verbatim resignation demand in the quoted statement.
proposals.name: Current and former players demand a meaningful voice in FIFA governance

proposals.definition: Samuel Eto'o's counter-position in the same stake-sale leadership dispute: defending Infantino, advocating re-election and reconsideration of FIFA Forward Enterprise through a democratic vote to improve the position of African football. This is a contested governance proposal, not an approved scheme or a separate completed election.
proposals.name: Eto'o defends Infantino and advocates reviving the FIFA financing proposal

proposals.definition: The research by Raquel Fernández, Inés Berniell and Milagros Onofri identified by NBER w35651, Falling Fertility: The Changing Value of Freedom, Fulfillment, and Family. The paper uses repeated cross-national surveys to study changes in fertility preferences and attitudes. It is not all falling fertility or Singapore's separate support package.
proposals.name: Fernández-Berniell-Onofri study of declining fertility preferences

proposals.definition: The study's connected decomposition of declining desired and intended childbearing into changing views of parental freedom, fulfillment without children and mothers' employment, including different contributions by education group. These are associated preference changes, not a demonstrated causal policy effect or separate studies for each attitude.
proposals.name: Freedom, fulfillment and maternal-work attitudes accompany lower intended fertility

proposals.definition: The specific August 2020 freight derailment near Llangennech, Carmarthenshire, involving DB Cargo operation, Touax wagons, a major fuel fire/spill and subsequent investigation, remediation and liability recovery. The named incident bounds the parent; unrelated rail accidents or claims at the same court are excluded.
proposals.name: August 2020 Llangennech freight derailment and its aftermath

proposals.definition: The civil damage-recovery strand concerning Network Rail's more-than-£5m High Court negligence claim against DB Cargo UK and Touax Rail for the Llangennech derailment, with wagon-maintenance allegations, RAIB brake findings and environmental damage explaining the claim. Allegations are not a liability judgment, and historical investigation/cleanup details do not establish new independent Stories.
proposals.name: Network Rail seeks negligence damages from DB Cargo and Touax

proposals.definition: The identifiable public intellectual exchange around Nicholas Decker's essay Academia Is Doing Fine, Actually and the Marginal Revolution response linked to it. The named work and response bound the Event, rather than all academic progress debates, all Monday links or the separately linked Rhine Group.
proposals.name: Nicholas Decker's Academia Is Doing Fine, Actually argument and response

proposals.definition: The response questioning a peaks-based defence of academia and economists' tendency to equate research quality with meaningful progress, emphasizing context-specific findings and limited broad usefulness. This is an argument about professional research evaluation, not a finding that a particular paper is false or a new institutional reform.
proposals.name: Research quality does not by itself demonstrate useful academic progress

proposals.definition: The identified late-August 2026 BTC/ETH market upswing discussed ahead of that week's Jackson Hole gathering, with easing-rate expectations, weaker payrolls and softer inflation as attributed drivers. This is a bounded market episode, not every crypto price report, the 2025 price peaks or an already announced Federal Reserve rate decision.
proposals.name: Late-August 2026 Bitcoin and Ethereum rally around Fed easing expectations

proposals.definition: The episode's August 24 price-and-outlook strand reporting BTC and ETH opening/morning gains and Butterfill's range-bound $80,000 test assessment. The two assets develop the same reported macro-linked rally; historical prices, buying instructions and an unfulfilled breakout scenario do not become separate Stories or completed market occurrences.
proposals.name: August 24 BTC/ETH gains and the $80,000 Bitcoin range test

proposals.definition: The named Gemini retail exchange/custody product programme offering simple trades, ActiveTrader and related account features under New York trust-company oversight. This stable service identity is broader than one review or fee observation, and excludes unrelated Gemini corporate transactions and other exchanges' product programmes.
proposals.name: Gemini's US retail crypto exchange and custody service

proposals.definition: The service-assessment strand weighing Gemini's custody, insurance, regulated trust structure, simple/advanced interfaces, fees and token selection, with staking, prediction markets and Gemini dollar as account capabilities. These details develop one consumer suitability comparison, not independent new product launches, a new regulator action or a verified security incident.
proposals.name: Gemini's security and regulatory safeguards versus trading costs and selection

proposals.definition: The Federal Reserve's specific 2026 process to modernize rules for depositor-owned mutual banking organizations, including capital-instrument treatment and procedural requirements. This is not the distinct Regulation O insider-credit revision announced the same day, unrelated bank enforcement or general monetary policy.
proposals.name: Federal Reserve 2026 mutual banking organization rulemaking

proposals.definition: The proposal-and-consultation strand clarifying regulatory capital instruments, increasing mutual-bank capital flexibility and reducing procedures while preserving depositor ownership. The 60-day Federal Register-relative comment period is not an inferred absolute deadline or proof the rule is final.
proposals.name: Proposed mutual-bank capital flexibility and reduced procedural burden

proposals.definition: The Federal Reserve's specific 2026 rulemaking revising Regulation O on credit to bank executives, directors and major shareholders, including threshold indexing and application clarifications. It is separate from the contemporaneous mutual-bank capital rulemaking and from individual insider misconduct proceedings.
proposals.name: Federal Reserve 2026 Regulation O insider-credit modernization

proposals.definition: The Regulation O proposal-and-consultation strand updating dollar thresholds and economic-growth indexing, simplifying application and maintaining protections against preferential treatment while facilitating community-bank governance. Thresholds and recruitment concerns are linked purposes of the same proposal, not separate enacted reforms.
proposals.name: Proposed updated insider-credit thresholds and governance safeguards

proposals.definition: The specifically numbered fifth Conference on the International Roles of the Dollar at the Federal Reserve Board in June 2026, with its two-day financial-innovation research proceedings. This conference edition is not every Fed speech, all dollar research or the separate Financial Inclusion Conference.
