proposals.name: Renewed Iran strike threats and depleted buffers raise crude-price risk

proposals.definition: The measured 2026 US stationary-storage buildout and utilization cycle, with utility-scale and residential deployment, tax-credit-related divergence and forecasts based on that buildout. The connected capacity-deployment process is broader than the Q2 report release; not all US energy developments or a new Event per statistic.
proposals.name: US 2026 stationary battery-capacity deployment cycle

proposals.definition: The deployment cycle's utility-scale growth strand: 20.2 GWh of Q2 additions, state leaders, greater grid supply and raised 2030 expectations. Factory supply and forecast metrics contextualize the same growth rather than establishing a Tesla factory-development Story from one mention.
proposals.name: Utility-scale projects drive record Q2 2026 battery additions

proposals.definition: The same capacity cycle's contrasting household-deployment strand, reporting a 27 percent year-over-year fall attributed to federal tax-credit changes. This is observed market contraction, not an inferred new legislative act.
proposals.name: Residential battery installations fall after tax-credit changes

proposals.definition: The identified Environmental Science & Technology study discussed by Jane Muncke of the Food Packaging Forum, examining hazardous chemicals in food-contact materials and missing risk-assessment information. The research question, institution, journal and reported findings bound this study; not all packaging regulation or each chemical separately.
proposals.name: Food Packaging Forum food-contact chemical safety-data study

proposals.definition: The study's hazard-and-evidence-gap strand: 1,222 concerning chemicals, missing information across much of the chemical inventory, and detected PFAS/phthalates in human samples. The counts and biomonitoring examples develop one exposure-assessment finding.
proposals.name: Hazardous food-contact chemicals lack adequate safety evidence

proposals.definition: The research's regulatory-response strand: mixture allocation factors, group restrictions and proving safety before market entry, contrasted with the Food Packaging Coalition's chemical-transfer assurance. Recommendations and disagreement do not establish adopted rules.
proposals.name: Researchers seek mixture-based and premarket packaging safeguards

proposals.definition: The identified 2026 European wind-power installation and permitting process assessed by WindEurope, spanning onshore/offshore additions and the connected policy conditions for that year's buildout. This bounded deployment cycle is not every European renewable project or publication of an industry report.
proposals.name: Europe 2026 wind-generation deployment cycle

proposals.definition: The deployment cycle's measured-installation and forecast strand: 8.8 GW in the first half, Germany's lead, Poland's offshore entry and a 24.1 GW full-year projection. Countries and totals are components of the regional buildout assessment, not automatically separate Events.
proposals.name: First-half wind additions support Europe record-year forecast

proposals.definition: The same cycle's enabling-policy strand: permit volumes fall in important markets, and WindEurope calls for streamlined EU rules to sustain deployment. This is a constraint and policy appeal, not an enacted EU reform.
proposals.name: Declining permit volumes threaten continued European wind growth

proposals.definition: The identifiable US distributed-home-storage ownership and financing transition linked to the end of homeowner Section 25D tax support, with providers testing incentives, customer ownership, third-party aggregation and utility leasing to sustain VPP deployment. This connected policy-induced market adaptation is not a formal joint programme of all named firms or generic battery financing.
proposals.name: US household battery financing transition after 25D credit withdrawal

proposals.definition: PSE&G's specifically announced customer-owned battery support programme with financing assistance and a $5,000 incentive. The utility, ownership model and incentive scheme bound the process; no unsupported affiliation to New Jersey's separately named Garden State Energy Storage Program is asserted.
proposals.name: PSE&G customer-owned home battery financing programme

proposals.definition: The PSE&G customer-ownership and entry-cost strand, with financing assistance and a $5,000 incentive. It belongs both to the identifiable utility programme and the article's broader post-25D financing transition; this does not merge the two Event identities.
proposals.name: PSE&G combines customer battery ownership with financing and incentives

proposals.definition: The transition's alternative ownership strand: Base Power/Palmetto aggregation, Evergy/Green Mountain Power installation and leasing, and Kikuma's third-party-dominance forecast. These alternatives are compared within the same policy-linked financing transition; each named provider is not presumed to share one contract.
proposals.name: Third-party ownership and utility leasing support home-storage aggregation

proposals.definition: Development of the CMIP7 seven-scenario emissions framework replacing the previous SSP set in climate-model comparison and assessment work. The named modeling programme and scenario generation bound a continuing research process, not all climate forecasting, one article or the distinct AI Model Intercomparison Project.
proposals.name: CMIP7 emissions-scenario framework development

proposals.definition: The framework's scenario-design and projected-range strand: reduced coal plausibility, a lower upper warming envelope and revised population/wealth assumptions. These are conditional scenario comparisons, not probabilities or an assured global temperature outcome.
proposals.name: CMIP7 narrows high-end warming through revised scenario assumptions

proposals.definition: The framework's low-pathway feasibility strand: reported mid-century warming peaks, failure to cut emissions rapidly after 2020 and substantial cumulative carbon-removal requirements. The frozen summary's contradictory sentence about avoiding overshoot remains unresolved; the numerical trajectory and removal dependence are retained without certifying that sentence.
proposals.name: CMIP7 low pathways face overshoot and carbon-removal dependence

proposals.definition: Institutional neutrality, accountability, evaluation methods and technology-selection governance in advice on public transport investment. Criticism is recorded as attributed analysis, not an automatic finding of misconduct or rejection of every technology.
proposals.name: Public transport technology advisory governance

proposals.definition: CUTRIC's identified ongoing transit-technology commercialization and investment-advisory process, including electric-bus interoperability and hydrogen-versus-direct-electric pathways. Its technology programme and advisory remit bound connected work, not CUTRIC as an all-purpose company Event or publication of one critique.
proposals.name: CUTRIC zero-emission transit commercialization and advisory work

proposals.definition: The attributed institutional-credibility strand connecting commercialization incentives, the claimed absence of mechanisms to stop failed forecasts and continued hydrogen-bus advocacy despite direct-electric progress. Battery interoperability success is part of the balanced governance argument, not a separately reported deployment project.
proposals.name: CUTRIC mission and pathway-review limits challenge advisory neutrality

proposals.definition: The identified Climate Risk Management research using 25,511 households across 37 countries to examine financial access, female-headed household resilience and gender empowerment under climate shocks. The study population, journal and research question bound one research process, not all women's financial inclusion studies.
proposals.name: Study of women financial access and climate resilience in sub-Saharan Africa

proposals.definition: The study's short-term buffering strand: formal financial access improves household ability to withstand economic crises from extreme weather and supports political/economic empowerment. This is an attributed empirical finding, not a universal causal guarantee.
proposals.name: Financial tools improve women-led households immediate climate-shock resilience

proposals.definition: The same study's structural-limit and policy strand: finance alone does not overcome drought/sea-level vulnerability or cultural barriers, motivating gender-sensitive credit and land-titling reforms. These limits qualify the immediate benefit rather than defining a separate study or an enacted reform.
proposals.name: Gender inequality limits financial inclusion long-run adaptation gains

proposals.definition: Methods, models and operational systems that predict atmospheric conditions and extreme weather, including ensemble forecasts and their accuracy and uncertainty.
proposals.name: Weather forecasting methods and systems

proposals.definition: Development and dissemination of Google's named WeatherNext generative forecasting system using Functional Generative Networks, including its global and cyclone ensemble capabilities. This is not a particular cyclone or all Google Earth AI projects.
proposals.name: Google WeatherNext generative weather-forecasting development

proposals.definition: The WeatherNext strand improving cyclone forecasts through fast, large generative ensembles that capture rare rapid intensification, with code and weights offered for research. Resolution, runtime and Weather Lab access explain this same forecasting advance.
proposals.name: WeatherNext cyclone ensemble forecasting and research access

proposals.definition: Access to inspectable AI models, training data, checkpoints and evaluation artifacts, and the infrastructure and collaborations enabling reproducible research.
proposals.name: Open AI research resources and reproducibility

proposals.definition: The identified collaboration between Ai2 and Hugging Face to distribute and support Ai2's open research artifacts on the Hugging Face Hub and connected developer tools, including its infrastructure expansion. proposals.definition: The collaboration's expansion strand increasing storage and removing traffic rate limits while distributing training data, checkpoints and evaluation tools. Download totals, LeRobot integration and future research support explain the same access initiative.
proposals.name: Expanded Hub capacity and access for reproducible Ai2 research

proposals.definition: Amazon's named Build on Trainium programme providing academic researchers with Trainium compute credits, resources and expertise for large-scale AI research. It is distinct from unrelated AWS grants or chip launches.
proposals.name: Amazon Build on Trainium academic research programme

proposals.definition: The award-round strand announcing 34 research grants and $110 million in compute credits to support responsible AI research, including safety, sustainability and synthetic data work. University examples describe the funded round rather than separate proven research outcomes.
proposals.name: Thirty-four Build on Trainium awards expand academic AI access

proposals.definition: The particular announcement of 34 Build on Trainium research grants described by Amazon Science. The article publication time is not certified as the instant all awards or credits took effect.
proposals.name: Announcement of the 34 Build on Trainium research grants

proposals.definition: Transmission, preservation and distribution of quantum states or entanglement for communications and interconnected quantum systems, including real-world fiber-network engineering.
proposals.name: Quantum networking and communication

proposals.definition: The identified NIST and collaborator research effort testing entangled-photon transmission over 62 kilometers of existing noisy aerial fiber in the Washington, DC suburbs using Qunnect polarization stabilization. It is not IBM's processor roadmap or quantum advantage benchmarking.
proposals.name: NIST and collaborators' stabilized aerial-fiber entanglement study

proposals.definition: The study's connected finding that real-time polarization control preserves entangled states despite wind and temperature disturbances on deployed fiber, with the 24-hour demonstration supporting practical quantum-network feasibility.
proposals.name: Real-time stabilization preserves entanglement on deployed aerial fiber

proposals.definition: The particular reported experiment sending entangled photons over 62 kilometers of aerial fiber with sustained stabilization over 24 hours. Its exact experimental dates are not inferred from the article timestamp.
proposals.name: The 62-kilometer, 24-hour aerial-fiber entanglement demonstration

proposals.definition: Models and methods that classify content against safety or moderation policies, including multimodal guardrails, configurable policy interpretation and calibrated decisions. This does not require that the evaluated content be AI-generated.
proposals.name: AI content-safety classification and guardrails

proposals.definition: Development and distribution of Mistral's specifically named Shieldstral 3B multimodal content-safety classifier. General Mistral product governance, frontier-policy campaigns and unrelated guardrail models are excluded.
proposals.name: Mistral Shieldstral development and open-weight release

proposals.definition: The Shieldstral introduction strand combining natural-language policy input, binary-question framing and unified text/image evaluation with calibrated scores, efficient operation and open-weight availability. proposals.name: Shieldstral policy-adaptive text and image safety classification

proposals.definition: The reported release and download availability of Shieldstral's open weights under Apache 2.0. No exact release instant or independently audited benchmark result is asserted.
proposals.name: Shieldstral open weights made available under Apache 2.0

proposals.definition: The GEM programme's training-systems strand increasing model FLOPs utilization and scaling through jagged/asymmetric attention kernels, mixed ultra-low precision, parallelism and topology-aware communication. proposals.name: GEM large-scale training efficiency through kernels and parallelism

proposals.definition: Development and dissemination of Microsoft's named Orchard open framework for scalable agent training and evaluation in deployment-like environments. Orchard Env and the SWE, GUI and Claw recipes are components of this framework, not unrelated agent releases.

proposals.definition: The framework introduction strand combining a Kubernetes environment service with domain-specific training recipes, data and evaluation methods to train small open-weight agents in real deployment harnesses. Domain benchmark figures support the shared framework approach.
proposals.name: Orchard scalable environments and deployment-aligned agent recipes

proposals.definition: The reported introduction of the open-source Orchard framework with environment infrastructure, training recipes, data and evaluation resources. Benchmark performance is reported evidence, not proof of production customer deployments.
proposals.name: Introduction of the open Orchard framework and research resources

proposals.definition: The HIR strand combining multimodal knowledge enrichment and engagement signals at multiple granularities to improve sparse and unseen-entity representation, with efficient graph learning, distillation and serving infrastructure supporting the same approach.
proposals.name: HIR fuses world knowledge and engagement for ad-interest representations

proposals.definition: The reported availability of Studio's prompt-and-skill management system to Mistral Studio customers. Availability does not prove that a named enterprise has deployed it.
proposals.name: Prompt and skill management available to Mistral Studio customers

proposals.definition: Recommendation feeds and controls that let users specify, adjust or exclude the content they receive, including persistent preferences and conversational customization.

proposals.name: Coddy survey links AI coding dependence with difficulty stopping and burnout

proposals.definition: Privacy, consent, surveillance risks and restrictions arising from camera-equipped wearable devices in shared spaces, including detection and enforcement limits.

proposals.definition: Selection, integration, public trust, institutional control and governance of data platforms used to coordinate health services and patient care. A commercial health-data platform is not assumed to use machine learning merely because its vendor also sells AI.

proposals.name: NHS England Palantir Federated Data Platform procurement and rollout

proposals.name: Grid-scale battery energy storage

proposals.name: GE Vernova selected for Supernode Stage 3 conversion and integration

proposals.name: Jurassic-source prospects motivate joint Mexican deepwater exploration

proposals.name: Minority investment aligns AI compute with power and data-center site development

proposals.definition: The specifically 2026 US natural-gas production cycle and its measured and forecast output, including basin contributions analyzed by EIA. It excludes other annual production cycles and particular new drilling projects not identified by this report.

proposals.definition: The separate university implementation strand moving science and medicine subjects from French to English, with concerns about contact hours, assessment, student preparation and contract teachers' disciplinary training. Its university experiment began in 2023-2024 according to the original; it is not the new third-year primary-school rule.
proposals.name: University English-medium transition and preparation concerns

proposals.definition: The specifically evidenced book-market transition at the named Libre Pensee bookshop in Tizi Ouzou, with bookseller Krimo Taleb reporting growing English sales and a shift beyond literature students' classic texts to general readers' contemporary fiction. This is the retailer/reader adoption process documented in the original, not an invented nationwide sales study or a consequence assumed to follow the state reform.
proposals.name: English-language retail/readership expansion at Libre Pensee in Tizi Ouzou

proposals.definition: The retail transition's reader-demand strand documenting increased English-language sales, particularly among young/female multilingual readers, and a broader general-public range of titles at Libre Pensee. Taleb says this interest precedes and is independent of government decisions. Named bestselling authors are examples, not new publication events.
proposals.name: Multilingual young readers broaden English-book demand

proposals.definition: The specifically attributed Ampere Analysis study of Netflix, Disney+ and Prime Video subscription price changes across global regions over the three years reported in August 2026, including the 2023-24 versus 2025-26 comparison. The named research, platforms and comparison window identify the assessment beyond this article; it is not one combined price-setting act by three independent firms.
proposals.name: Ampere Analysis's 2026 comparative streaming-subscription pricing research

proposals.definition: The study's comparative pricing/monetization strand finding Western Europe's USD 1.86 average monthly rise above the US USD 1.70 rise, while willingness-to-pay constraints reduce the size of later increases and streamers use ads and differentiated tiers. Company prices and Netflix UK revenues support this market assessment rather than independently certify new price announcements or creative releases.
proposals.name: Western Europe's leading price rises and slowing streaming-price increases

proposals.definition: Physical extreme-weather episodes and natural disasters, their regional impacts, casualties and displacement. A storm report does not itself establish climate-change attribution or a forecasting-method development, and separate named storms remain different events.
proposals.name: Extreme weather and natural disasters

proposals.definition: The specifically named Typhoon Narra storm episode documented by the August 24, 2026 Al Jazeera report as affecting northern Vietnam and southern China. The named storm positively connects those regions. Other typhoons or years are excluded; no precise landfall time or storm-track history is certified.
proposals.name: Typhoon Narra's 2026 storm episode affecting Vietnam and China

proposals.definition: The storm's regional flood-impact strand reporting heavy rainfall, flooding, thousands displaced and at least one death in northern Vietnam, alongside effects in southern China. The countries and casualty measures are aspects of one explicitly storm-linked impact account, not independent storm events or a single identified local flood occurrence.
proposals.name: Narra-related flooding and displacement in northern Vietnam and southern China
